
===== 2026-08-06 04:38:30 layout=pieces/chtpm/layouts/event_ez.chtpm =====
+==========================================+
| EVENT EDITOR — m6_golddeity               |
+==========================================+
What is this? Each PAGE is one event script
(like RPG Maker Event pages). Open a page,
then add commands (e.g. Change Gold).
------------------------------------------
HOW TO: number or arrows, then Enter.
------------------------------------------
-- EVENT PAGES --
[>] 1. [Page 1 - When: on_click (0 cmd)]
[ ] 2. [Page 2 - (new empty page)]
------------------------------------------
widget profile: GL primary; SHOW_ASCII=0

+=========================================================+
Nav > _

===== 2026-08-06 04:38:32 layout=pieces/chtpm/layouts/event_ez_page_1.chtpm =====
+==========================================+
| EVENT PAGE 1 — m6_golddeity              |
+==========================================+
When does this page run? (RMMV Trigger)
| [>] 1. Trigger: on_click / on_spawn / parallel: []                                        |
[ ] 2. [Save Trigger]
------------------------------------------
-- EVENT COMMANDS (runs top to bottom) --
Pick [New Event Command] to add a line.
[ ] 3. [New Event Command...]
------------------------------------------
[ ] 4. [< Back to Event Pages]
widget profile: GL primary; SHOW_ASCII=0

+=========================================================+
